steps: Apply at puls.com/join for your trade
Get approved and install the Technician App

Get paid three times a week via direct deposit

biggest_catch: The '$60 per hour' headline is a ceiling — technicians earn flat per-job fees, so a quick job pays well per hour and a tricky one doesn't.

weasel_words.quote: 'Earn up to $60 per hour' — ceiling; flat per-job fees mean effective hourly pay varies by job difficulty.

repeatable.cadence: Pick a job from the Technician App, complete the repair or install at the customer's home, and get paid three times a week — repeat with every job you claim.

maximize: Pick jobs you can finish fast — flat-fee pay rewards speed, so a 45-minute TV mount beats a 2-hour troubleshooting slog; learn extra service lines (phone repair plus TV mounting) to widen the jobs you're offered; cluster jobs in one area per day; keep ratings perfect since Puls routes the best jobs to top technicians.
who_pays: Puls pays you via direct deposit three times a week for the jobs you complete — the flat per-job fee comes from Puls, not from the customer on-site.
who_qualifies: You need real experience in a trade (TV mounting, phone repair, handyman work, appliance repair), be authorized to work in the US, have reliable transportation, and use the Puls Technician App on a smartphone.
work_available: You pick jobs from the Technician App — but which jobs you're offered depends on your ratings, and volume varies by market. Flat per-job pay means quick jobs pay well per hour and tricky ones don't.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid a flat fee for each completed job. Your ratings determine which jobs you're offered — top technicians get routed the best work. Puls's specific non-payment triggers and removal policy are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Applying is officially free, and Puls supplies the parts and tools for each job itself. Your vehicle, gas, and maintenance are on you, plus self-employment taxes. Unpaid time: the application process, waiting for good jobs to appear, and driving between customers.
when_cash_arrives: Direct deposit to your bank three times a week — faster than most platforms' weekly pay, but still not same-day.
